voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack - Deep Dark Horror Narrator (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), one take split into lines, atempo 1.06; the intruder line: espeak-ng + MBROLA us2, rate 150, pitch 24 (the ElevenLabs fiction-voice generation failed)

lines.text: The man on your television is still talking. But that is not his voice.
lines.beat_before: hook: the newsreader on the CRT, lips moving, the hum

lines.text: Southern England. A Saturday in November, nineteen seventy seven.
lines.beat_before: the terraced street at dusk, the mast on the hill

lines.text: Ten past five. Families sit down to the early evening news.
lines.beat_before: the living room: the family, the clock at 5:10

lines.text: Then the sound dissolves into a low hum.
lines.beat_before: the TV: the picture holds, the sound starts to go

lines.text: This is the voice of Vrillon, a representative of the Ashtar Galactic Command, speaking to you.
For six minutes, the picture never changes. The newsreader's lips keep moving.
lines.beat_before: stinger in silence; subliminal: the room seen from inside the TV

lines.text: The voice tells everyone to give up their weapons. That there is only a short time left.
lines.beat_before: the frozen family; the lips out of sync

lines.text: On a hill in Hampshire, one transmitter is passing it on to the homes below.
lines.beat_before: the mast on the hill; the transmitter hut, the sound meter pinned

lines.text: Then the news comes back, as if nothing had happened.
lines.beat_before: the sound snaps back: stinger, jolt

lines.text: The station apologises. The broadcasting authority calls it a hoax.
Nearly fifty years later, no one knows whose voice it was.
lines.beat_before: stinger in silence: the TV glass, the room reflected

lines.text: Or where it was really coming from.
